articles.title: MCP 2026-07-28 spec is live: stateless core, no more sessions The fifth MCP spec dropped yesterday. Bigg…
articles.summary: The fifth MCP spec, dated 2026-07-28, is now live and makes the protocol stateless. The biggest change is a shift from bidirectional stateful communication to pure request/response, which removes handshakes, session IDs, and sticky routing so any request can go to any server instance. Several features — HTTP+SSE transport, roots, sampling, and logging — are deprecated with a 12-month transition period. The spec also adds header-based routing through Mcp-Method and Mcp-Name, and replaces server-initiated calls with Multi Round-Trip Requests.
